lines.en: Sparks still come off my feathers.
I hop twice on the ground.
One beat of my wings and I am up.
I do not fly high, but I am quick.
Young, my fire only reaches my feet.
I skim the grass and the tips scorch.
That hop carries me far.
I circle a stone.
I beat my wings and surge forward.
My tail trails a little fire.

lines.zh: 我在半空熄了一下，又亮。
lines.en: I dim in the air, then brighten.
I am young, not slow.
I land on a branch and the fire stays.
My feathers are still soft.
Fire beats in my chest.
I wait for it to burn brighter.
The warm wind crosses my crest.
I do nothing; I just stand.
The air here is not hot enough.
I tilt my head at the flame.
I shake and sparks scatter.

lines.zh: 我在灰里扒出还热的炭。
lines.en: I scratch warm coals out of the ash.

lines.zh: 你看见我身上的火了吗。
lines.en: Do you see the fire on me?
Even a young phoenix burns.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛还没换成硬羽。
lines.en: My down has not turned to hard feathers yet.
Something in your hand glints.
I am young, and I still burn.
Step back.
I dislike being watched.
Are you going to catch me?
Once I fly, I am fast.
Your hair is about to singe.
A patch of my feathers is scorched.
Two feathers fell.
I curl up, and my fire shrinks.
I cry out in pain.
I fly crooked for a stretch.
Half my fire went out.
A chunk of my tail feathers has burned away.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛上还跳着火星。
lines.en: Sparks still dance on my feathers.
My glow dimmed.
I will burn again.
What is that? Will it burn?

lines.zh: 你把谷粒举给我，我嫌凉。
lines.en: You offer grain, but it feels cold to me.
Hold it up and let me look.
I am not afraid of fire. You should not be either.
It melted in front of me.
Do you have something else?
I come down a little.
I breathe on it.
Now it is burning.
I do not quite know what to do with it.
Bump into me and your hand will burn.
One roll and I climb.
Sparks land on your sleeve.
Your bump sends me into a somersault.

lines.zh: 我掉下几根还在烧的绒。
lines.en: A few burning tufts fall off me.
One turn to steady myself.
Not grown yet, and my fire already burns.
That bump was nothing.
I rise a little higher.
You know what closeness costs.
I am still too small.
Ask me about that later.
Another firebird is far off.
Its fire burns hotter than mine.
We circle the same tree.
Fire leaps between us.
We land together and glow together.
The night is lit.
We fly our separate ways.
Ask me again when I have grown.
Will that catch fire?
I take it in my claws.
It is smoking.
Too hot. I drop it.
I like this one.
I carry it up to a branch.
It caught fire in my beak.

lines.zh: 我用爪子抓住这块亮东西。
lines.en: I grip the shiny thing in my talons.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进巢里的灰。
lines.en: I tuck the thing into the ash of my nest.
It has burned away already.

lines.zh: 我盯住你了，羽毛还在冒火。
lines.en: I have fixed on you; my feathers still smoke.
There is heat on you.
I lower my wings.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一收，就要扑下去。
lines.en: I fold my wings, about to dive.
I need not close in. I have fire.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我刚烧过的地。
lines.en: You stepped on ground I just burned.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边烧着。
lines.en: My shadow burns at your feet.
I am above you.
Locked on, my feathers burn first.
My feathers light up first.
Guess where I will strike.
I am small, but my fireball burns.
I am behind you now.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛开始发亮，你得走开。
lines.en: My feathers are starting to glow — you should leave.
My chest grows hot again.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶张开了爪子。
lines.en: I spread my talons above your head.
I circle you as I fly.
Your head turns to follow me.
The flame almost touches you.

lines.zh: 我翅一扇，火星就落下去。
lines.en: One beat of my wings drops sparks.
You raise a hand to block.
That will not stop fire.
I press in a little more.
All my feathers are alight.
Your clothes are smoking.
You are backing away.
I am small, but my fireballs are not few.
I wait for you to stop.
Stopped.
My beak is open.
Fire comes from it.
All of this will burn.
Do you hear the crackling?
I am directly above you.
I fold my wings.

lines.zh: 我压低，翅尖擦过你的肩。
lines.en: I drop low, my wingtip grazing your shoulder.
I spit a burst of flame.
The fireball grazes your shoulder.
I rake down with my claws.
That came with sparks.
You are forced back two steps.
Your sleeve is on fire.
I beat my wings and the fire spreads.
That was not enough.
Another burst.

lines.zh: 我吐出的一小团火落在草上。
lines.en: The small fireball I spit lands in the grass.
I dive and strike.

lines.zh: 我的身体还很小，火不小。
lines.en: I am small. My fire is not.
Grass burns in two places.
I climb and watch the fire.
I land and the dry grass curls up.

lines.zh: 我扇翅，火星扑到你脸上。
lines.en: I beat my wings and sparks fly into your face.
Move again and I spit again.
It is burning.
Burning nicely.
I watch.
I begin as a small ball of fire.
Sparks scatter and I take shape.
This branch suits me.
The air here is cool.
First I shake off the ash.
My feathers are not all grown.
I see fire in the distance.
The fire on my wings isn't hot yet.
I land on dead wood.
It is starting to smoke.
This is my first flight.
I wobble.
Fire does not hurt me. It makes me brighter.
I hit the ground and sparks scatter.

lines.zh: 水一浇，我'嘶'的一声熄了半边。
lines.en: Water hits and half of me hisses out.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把火都吹散了。
lines.en: The blast blows my flames apart.

lines.zh: 一根东西穿过我的翅膀。
lines.en: Something passed through my wing.
My fire is being pressed down.
Hungry this long, my fire weakens.

lines.zh: 雷电交在一起，我差点散了。
lines.en: The lightning tangled with mine and I nearly scattered.

lines.zh: 下面没有空气，火烧不起来。
lines.en: No air below. My fire will not catch.
